$description: Start-screen + persona contract (waves XIII–XIV W2, ref start.png — «ВЫБОР ИИ АГЕНТА»): per-assistant accent for the select grid, window frame and status labels. personaAccent mirrors each persona theme's accent.primary (decoration: borders, glow — non-text, ≥3:1). personaEdge = persona color for hairlines/frame edges, guaranteed ≥3:1 on the block's own panel (light shells override darker). personaText = persona color used AS text, guaranteed ≥4.5:1 on the block's own panel (light shells override darker — NQ-081 closure: assistant identity legible on the ivory shell). Values = primitive refs only.

alice.$description: AGENT-A — gold.700, accent.primary of theme alice.

mech.$description: M.E.C.H. — blue.500, accent.primary of theme mech.

forge.$description: AGENT-B — amber.500, accent.primary of theme forge.

codex.$description: AGENT-C — gold.600, accent.primary of theme codex.

arch.$description: A.R.C.H. — violet.400, accent.primary of theme arch.

nexus.$description: NEXUS (ядро, не в сетке выбора) — gold.500, accent.primary of root theme.

personaEdge.$description: Persona color for hairlines and the window-frame edge — ≥3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11 non-text) on the block's surface.panel. Root values = dark-shell canon; the alice block re-points forge/arch/nexus one step darker so the frame stays visible on ivory (NQ-081). Bind: [data-persona] → --nexus-window-frame-hairline.

personaText.$description: Persona color used as TEXT (status labels, signatures, names) — ≥4.5:1 on the block's surface.panel AND surface.elevated, both polarities. Root = dark-shell values (alice steps UP to gold.500: gold.700 is only 3.52:1 on obsidian). The alice block overrides all six to darker steps for the ivory shell; mech/forge/codex re-point still lighter on their lighter elevated (NQ-088 re-check).

alice.$description: AGENT-A on dark shells — gold.500 (7.37:1); gold.700 reserved for her own light block.

mech.$description: NQ-088 re-check: blue.500 is 4.20:1 on nexus elevated — blue.400 holds 5.73.

personaGlow.$description: Selected-card halo per assistant — 24px soft glow at 30% of personaAccent, same falloff as glow.active.
